them.mo_ta: Added individually defined shoreline boulders and rock outcrops beside the near bastion and the landward end of the long mole; BEFORE has a substantially smoother sandy and grassy foreshore.
Added exposed boulders along the narrow foreshore beneath the central waterfront fortifications, replacing portions of the smooth grassy bank.
Added small rocky projections and exposed shoreline rocks around and beyond the distant waterfront bastions.
Added a conspicuous patch of raised bushes and scrub between the left-edge houses and the near fortification; this area is predominantly flat grass in BEFORE.

bot_doi.mo_ta: The smooth sandy foreshore beside the near bastion has been changed into an irregular boulder-strewn shore; the land itself remains present.
Parts of the continuous grassy strip outside the central waterfront walls have been replaced by exposed shoreline rocks.

them.mo_ta: Rocky shoreline with boulders and white surf added along the coast below the fortifications. In BEFORE this was a smooth sand strip and green grass.
Pale limestone rock outcrops and cliff faces added on the hillside (BEFORE had smooth scree and grass).
Dry scrub added on the grassy strip beside the shore (grass was smooth green in BEFORE).

bot_doi.mo_ta: Smooth green grass strip along the shore was replaced by rock and scrub.
